Libraries and Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

install.packages("janitor")
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
SurveyResponses <- read_excel("SurveyResponses.xlsx")
View(SurveyResponses)
```


```{r}
SurveyResponses %>%
  names()

score_map <- c(
  "Definitely willing" = 4,
  "Probably willing" = 3,
  "Unsure" = 2,
  "Probably not willing" = 1,
  "Definitely not willing" = 0
)

# Calculate average score from dataset column
average_score <- SurveyResponses %>%
  mutate(score = score_map[WillingnessTest]) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE))

average_score

average_score <- SurveyResponses %>%
  mutate(score = score_map[WillingnessTestPaid]) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE))

average_score

average_score <- SurveyResponses %>%
  mutate(score = score_map[SampleCollectionCorrect]) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE))

average_score

average_score <- SurveyResponses %>%
  mutate(score = score_map[AccurateResults]) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE))

average_score

average_score <- SurveyResponses %>%
  mutate(score = score_map[AccuratelyInterpretResults]) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE))

average_score

average_score <- SurveyResponses %>%
  mutate(score = score_map[PositiveTestNextSteps]) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE))

average_score



# Define keywords for sample types
methods <- c("Oral swab", "Urine sample", "Finger prick")

# Count number of methods selected per row
SampleSummary <- SurveyResponses %>%
  mutate(
    # Split each entry into individual methods
    items = str_split(SampleMethod, pattern = ",\\s*"),
    
    # Count how many of the 3 methods appear
    method_count = sapply(items, function(x) sum(methods %in% x))
  )

# Frequency of each original choice
choice_counts <- SampleSummary %>%
  count(SampleMethod)

# Count how many selected 1, 2, or 3 methods
count_by_number <- SampleSummary %>%
  count(method_count)

choice_counts



# Define notification methods
methods <- c("Email", "Call", "Physical mail", "Secure website login")

# Analyze the ResultNotification column
ResultSummary <- SurveyResponses %>%
  mutate(
    # Split each entry into individual methods
    items = str_split(ResultNotification, pattern = ",\\s*"),
    
    # Count how many methods appear in the entry
    method_count = sapply(items, function(x) sum(methods %in% x))
  )

# Count frequency of each exact choice
choice_counts <- ResultSummary %>%
  count(ResultNotification)

# Count how many selected 1, 2, 3, or 4 methods
count_by_number <- ResultSummary %>%
  count(method_count)

choice_counts
count_by_number

```
